title: Settlement Percentage by Time Since Sale — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Deficiencies
content:
The percentage of a deficiency on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract that a lump-sum settlement must reach follows how long ago the vehicle was sold. The age is counted in calendar days from the sale date recorded on the contract to the settlement date, the day the settlement figure is stated.

| Days from the sale date to the settlement date | Age percentage |
|---|---|
| No more than 90 (the recent-sale days) | 80 percent, the recent-sale percentage |
| More than 90 and no more than 180 (the mid-age days) | 70 percent, the mid-age percentage |
| More than 180 | the minimum settlement percentage for the tier |

### Boundaries

| Days since the sale | Age percentage |
|---|---|
| 90 | 80 percent |
| 91 | 70 percent |
| 180 | 70 percent |
| 181 | the minimum settlement percentage for the tier |

**Hypothetical.** A vehicle sold on the 1st of a month whose settlement figure is stated 120 days later carries an age percentage of 70 percent.
